Sampling is an estimate with retained cadence, not byte-exact allocator use. kernel observes freshly built owned extension plus independent Counter/Dijkstra oracles; native KiCad gates remain separate. Final-source-parity identifies benchmark-to-primary run/configuration parity; environment and input identities are also retained by each comparison, not inferred from a green verdict. Final f0f73da caches only major-based environment-name selection within run_attempt; actual full kicad-cli version/hash identity APIs remain uncached, covered by independent full-identity freshness tests. The new matrix invokes frozen primary directly with prepared603; prior prepared-bytecode performance results are historical. All new warmup/measured native outcomes and1.10 gates remain mandatory.
